is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotype frequencies for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (Page 10, Table 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 7 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) and allelic frequencies for An. coluzzii and An. gambiae (Page 10).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Côte d'Ivoire (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data collected in 2016 (Page 3, Methods).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in 40 villages across five health districts in the Gbêkê region, Côte d'Ivoire (Page 2, Methods; Page 6, Table 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study specifies collection occurred between November and December 2016 (Page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a baseline study for a specific CRT trial conducted in 2016, and the authors state it is a descriptive analysis of entomological indicators.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and site-level information, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study reports the entomological indicators and insecticide resistance marker frequencies (kdr L1014F and ace-1 G119S) for Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii) collected in 40 villages in central Côte d'Ivoire in 2016.
